panels.description: Plain-language answer to 'can I use GenAI Hub right now?'. Derived from live gateway success rate over the selected window. Detail for every model is in the provider sections below.

-1.text: Service unavailable — we are working on it

0.text: No recent traffic — status cannot be confirmed

1.text: Major disruption — most requests are failing

2.text: Degraded — some requests are failing, retries advised

3.text: Minor degradation — occasional failures, safe to use

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
    AzureDiagnostics,
    workspace("aa6cc9fc-f7cd-4720-9403-2ffaca04fd83").AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT"
    and Category == "GatewayLogs"
| extend Code=toint(column_ifexists("responseCode_d", 0))
| summarize Requests=count(), Failures=countif(Code >= 500)
| extend AvailabilityPct=iff(
    Requests == 0,
    real(null),
    100.0 * todouble(Requests - Failures) / todouble(Requests)
  )
| project Value=case(
    Requests == 0, 0,
    AvailabilityPct >= 97.0, 4,
    AvailabilityPct >= 95.0, 3,
    AvailabilityPct >= 90.0, 2,
    1
  )

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let LiveStatus = union
    AzureDiagnostics,
    workspace("aa6cc9fc-f7cd-4720-9403-2ffaca04fd83").AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT"
    and Category == "GatewayLogs"
| extend Code=toint(column_ifexists("responseCode_d", 0))
| summarize
    Requests=count(),
    Failures=countif(Code >= 500),
    Throttled=countif(Code == 429),
    LastObservedCall=max(TimeGenerated)
| extend AvailabilityPct=iff(
    Requests == 0,
    real(null),
    round(100.0 * todouble(Requests - Failures) / todouble(Requests), 3)
  )
| extend Status=case(
    Requests == 0, "Status unknown",
    AvailabilityPct >= 97.0, "Operational",
    AvailabilityPct >= 95.0, "Minor degradation",
    AvailabilityPct >= 90.0, "Degraded performance",
    "Major service disruption"
  )
| extend ConsumerImpact=case(
    Requests == 0, "No recent gateway traffic was observed, so current runtime health cannot be confirmed.",
    AvailabilityPct >= 97.0, "No widespread platform impact is visible in observed gateway traffic.",
    AvailabilityPct >= 95.0, "Some consumers may experience intermittent server-side failures.",
    AvailabilityPct >= 90.0, "Elevated server-side failures may affect multiple consumers or models.",
    "A broad service disruption is likely based on the observed server-error rate."
  )
| extend Guidance=case(
    Requests == 0, "Do not interpret this as healthy. Run a normal test request or check again after traffic resumes.",
    AvailabilityPct >= 97.0, "Continue normal use. Report repeated failures with timestamp, model and request or correlation ID.",
    AvailabilityPct >= 95.0, "Retry transient failures with exponential backoff and check the model cards below.",
    AvailabilityPct >= 90.0, "Use retry and backoff, consider an approved alternative model or region, and follow service communications.",
    "Pause non-critical workloads, use an approved fallback where available, and follow incident communications."
  )
| project
    Sort=1,
    Category="Live service status",
    Status,
    Message=ConsumerImpact,
    Guidance,
    AvailabilityPct,
    Requests,
    Throttled,
    LastObservedCall;
let TeamNotice = datatable(
    Severity:string,
    Title:string,
    Message:string,
    StartsAt:datetime,
    EndsAt:datetime
)[
"Information", "No active GenAI Hub advisory", "No additional platform-wide advisory is currently published by the GenAI Hub team.", datetime(2026-07-29T00:00:00Z), datetime(null)
]
| where StartsAt <= now() and (isnull(EndsAt) or EndsAt >= now())
| project
    Sort=2,
    Category="GenAI Hub notice",
    Status=Severity,
    Message=strcat(Title, ": ", Message),
    Guidance="Continue to monitor this page for incident, maintenance and lifecycle updates.",
    AvailabilityPct=real(null),
    Requests=long(null),
    Throttled=long(null),
    LastObservedCall=datetime(null);
union LiveStatus, TeamNotice
| order by Sort asc
| project Category, Status, Message, Guidance, AvailabilityPct,
    Requests, Throttled, LastObservedCall

azureResourceGraph.query:
ServiceHealthResources
| extend
    Status=tostring(properties.Status),
    EventType=tostring(properties.EventType),
    Level=tostring(properties.Level),
    Title=tostring(properties.Title),
    TrackingId=tostring(properties.TrackingId),
    LastUpdateTime=todatetime(properties.LastUpdateTime)
| where Status =~ "Active" or LastUpdateTime > ago(30d)
| mv-expand Impact=properties.Impact
| extend Service=tostring(Impact.ImpactedService)
| where Service contains "OpenAI"
    or Service contains "AI"
    or Service contains "Cognitive"
    or Service contains "API Management"
| mv-expand RegionItem=Impact.ImpactedRegions
| extend
    Region=tostring(RegionItem.ImpactedRegion),
    RegionStatus=tostring(RegionItem.Status)
| where Region in~ ("Sweden Central", "East US 2", "West Europe", "Global")
| summarize Regions=make_set(Region, 10),
    RegionStates=make_set(RegionStatus, 10)
  by LastUpdateTime, Status, EventType, Level, Service, TrackingId, Title
| extend
    ImpactedRegions=strcat_array(Regions, ", "),
    RegionalStatus=strcat_array(RegionStates, ", ")
| project
    LastUpdateTime,
    Status,
    EventType,
    Level,
    Service,
    ImpactedRegions,
    RegionalStatus,
    TrackingId,
    Title
| order by Status asc, LastUpdateTime desc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Inventory=datatable(
    Role:string,
    Capability:string,
    SortOrder:int
)[
"orchestrator", "Document orchestration", 1,
"documentparsing", "Document parsing", 2,
"chunking", "Chunking", 3,
"embedding", "Embedding", 4,
"vectorstorage", "Vector storage", 5,
"cognitiveservice", "Cognitive services", 6
];
let Runtime=union isfuzzy=true
    AppRequests,
    workspace("aa6cc9fc-f7cd-4720-9403-2ffaca04fd83").AppRequests
| extend
    Role=iff(isempty(AppRoleName), "unknown", AppRoleName),
    Code=toint(ResultCode)
| where Role in (
    "orchestrator",
    "documentparsing",
    "chunking",
    "embedding",
    "vectorstorage",
    "cognitiveservice"
  )
| summarize
    Requests=sum(ItemCount),
    ServerFailures=sumif(
      ItemCount,
      Code >= 500 or (Success == false and Code == 0)
    ),
    Throttled=sumif(ItemCount, Code == 429),
    P95DurationMs=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 2),
    LastCall=max(TimeGenerated)
  by Role;
Inventory
| join kind=leftouter Runtime on Role
| extend
    Requests=tolong(coalesce(Requests, 0)),
    ServerFailures=tolong(coalesce(ServerFailures, 0)),
    Throttled=tolong(coalesce(Throttled, 0))
| extend AvailabilityPct=iff(
    Requests == 0,
    real(null),
    round(
      100.0 * todouble(Requests - ServerFailures) / todouble(Requests),
      3
    )
  )
| extend Status=case(
    Requests == 0, "Status unknown — no recent traffic",
    AvailabilityPct >= 97.0, "Operational",
    AvailabilityPct >= 95.0, "Minor degradation",
    AvailabilityPct >= 90.0, "Degraded performance",
    "Major service disruption"
  )
| extend HealthScore=case(
    Requests == 0, 0,
    Status == "Major service disruption", 1,
    Status == "Degraded performance", 2,
    Status == "Minor degradation", 3,
    4
  )
| extend TileColor=case(
    Requests == 0, "#6B7280",
    Status == "Major service disruption", "#E02F44",
    Status == "Degraded performance", "#FF9830",
    Status == "Minor degradation", "#F2CC0C",
    "#299C46"
  )
| project
    SortOrder,
    TileName=Capability,
    HealthScore,
    TileColor,
    Capability,
    Status,
    AvailabilityPct,
    Requests,
    ServerFailures,
    Throttled,
    P95DurationMs,
    LastCall
| order by SortOrder asc

panels.title: Published Model Retirement Schedule

options.content:
**Operational** ≥97% availability · **Minor degradation** 95–<97% · **Degraded performance** 90–<95% · **Major service disruption** <90% · **Status unknown** when there is no recent traffic.

Model cards combine Azure deployment readiness with observed gateway success. Status unknown does not mean unavailable or healthy.

**Retirement risk:** Critical ≤30 days · High ≤90 days · Watch ≤180 days. A model absent from the table has no published retirement date in the captured schedule; that does not guarantee indefinite support. Source: [Microsoft Foundry model retirement schedule](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/openai/concepts/model-retirement-schedule).

| summarize
    Model=any(Model),
    ProvisionedDeployments=countif(Provisioning == "Succeeded"),
    NotReadyDeployments=countif(Provisioning != "Succeeded")
  by Deployment;
let Runtime = union
    AzureDiagnostics,
    workspace("aa6cc9fc-f7cd-4720-9403-2ffaca04fd83").AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.APIMANAGEMENT"
    and Category == "GatewayLogs"
| extend Deployment=extract(
    @"(?i)/deployments/([^/?]+)",
    1,
    tostring(column_ifexists("url_s", ""))
  ),
  Code=toint(column_ifexists("responseCode_d", 0))
| where isnotempty(Deployment)
| summarize
    Requests=count(),
    Failures=countif(Code >= 500),
    LastCall=max(TimeGenerated)
  by Deployment;
InventoryByDeployment
| join kind=leftouter Runtime on Deployment
| extend Requests=tolong(coalesce(Requests, 0)),
    Failures=tolong(coalesce(Failures, 0))
| summarize
    ProvisionedDeployments=sum(ProvisionedDeployments),
    NotReadyDeployments=sum(NotReadyDeployments),
    Requests=sum(Requests),
    Failures=sum(Failures),
    LastCall=max(LastCall)
  by Model
| extend AvailabilityPct=iff(
    Requests == 0,
    real(null),
    round(100.0 * todouble(Requests - Failures) / todouble(Requests), 2)
  )
| extend Status=case(
    ProvisionedDeployments == 0, "Unavailable",
    Requests == 0, "No recent traffic",
    AvailabilityPct >= 97.0, "Operational",
    AvailabilityPct >= 95.0, "Minor degradation",
    AvailabilityPct >= 90.0, "Degraded performance",
    "Major service disruption"
  )
| extend HealthScore=case(
    Status == "Unavailable", -1,
    Status == "No recent traffic", 0,
    Status == "Major service disruption", 1,
    Status == "Degraded performance", 2,
    Status == "Minor degradation", 3,
    4
  )
| extend TileColor=case(
    Status == "Unavailable", "#8A0000",
    Status == "No recent traffic", "#6B7280",
    Status == "Major service disruption", "#E02F44",
    Status == "Degraded performance", "#FF9830",
    Status == "Minor degradation", "#F2CC0C",
    "#299C46"
  )
| project
    TileName=Model,
    HealthScore,
    TileColor,
    Status,
    AvailabilityPct,
    Requests,
    Failures,
    ProvisionedDeployments,
    NotReadyDeployments,
    LastCall
| order by TileName asc

options.content:
## Using GenAI Hub well

**Pick the smallest model that does the job.** Capability and price differ by roughly 5x
between tiers. Try the smaller model first and only move up if quality genuinely falls short.

**Reuse your system prompt.** If the same instructions lead every request, prompt caching
makes repeat reads about **10x cheaper** than fresh input on every model. It pays back only
when the cached content is actually reused, so cache stable instructions - not per-user text.

**Ask for shorter answers.** Generated tokens cost around **5x** what input tokens cost.
Setting a sensible `max_tokens` and asking for concise output is usually the single biggest
saving available.

**Retrieve, don't stuff.** Embeddings cost around **EUR 0.10 per 1M tokens**. Searching a
vector index and passing a few relevant passages is far cheaper than pasting whole documents
into every prompt.

**Watch long context.** Very large prompts move onto a long-context meter charged at about
**2x** the standard input rate. Trimming a prompt back under the threshold halves that cost.

**Check the retirement schedule** on this page before pinning a model version, so you are not
migrating under time pressure.

## What things cost

Actual blended rates, **EUR per 1,000,000 tokens**, from Azure billing. Use them to sanity-check
design choices before you build.

| Model | Input | Output | Cached input |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Opus 4.8 | 4.27 | 21.36 | 0.43 |
| Claude Sonnet 4.6 | 2.54 | 12.71 | 0.25 |
| Claude Haiku 4.5 | 0.86 | 4.29 | 0.09 |
| GPT-5 family (avg) | 1.68 | 7.78 | 0.32 |
| GPT-5.4 | 1.54 | 9.25 | 0.15 |
| GPT-5.4-mini | 0.47 | 2.78 | 0.05 |
| Kimi K2.6 | 0.48 | 2.16 | 0.10 |

**Three things this table tells you**

1. **Output dominates.** Opus output is 5x its input. A chatty prompt is cheap; a chatty
   *answer* is not.
2. **Tier choice matters more than prompt tuning.** Haiku to Opus is a 5x jump on both input
   and output. GPT-5.4-mini is roughly 3x cheaper than GPT-5.4.
3. **Caching is the best lever you are probably not using.** Cached input runs about 10% of
   normal input everywhere. Writing to cache costs slightly more than a normal input token,
   so it wins on reuse, not on one-offs.

## When something looks wrong

**You get HTTP 429.** You are being rate limited. Back off exponentially and retry - do not
retry immediately in a tight loop. The platform may already be steering your traffic to
another region on your behalf.

**Responses feel slower than usual.** Requests can be served from a different region when the
primary is busy or degraded. This is deliberate and keeps you serving rather than failing.
Do not assume a fixed region.

**Every request fails with HTTP 400.** Check your model deployment name first. The most common
cause is a name that does not exist - including template placeholders that were never
substituted. A wrong name fails at the gateway before it ever reaches a model.

**A capability shows degraded above.** No action needed from you. Check the incident table at
the top for the current advisory and expected resolution.

**Before raising a ticket**, please include: the model name you called, an approximate
timestamp, the HTTP status you received, and your application or subscription name. That is
usually enough to find the request in the logs immediately.
